sources.title: ookami_mio_(casual)
sources.excerpt:
The 3rd [[official alternate costume|costume]] of [[hololive]]'s [[Ookami Mio]], in chronological order, as seen in post #3724399 and post #3724400. It comes in 2 versions, one with a hoodie and another with a white shirt.

The former consists of a [[two-tone hoodie|two-tone]] [[black hoodie|black]] and [[white hoodie]] with a [[paw print pattern]] and [[sleeves past wrists|sleeves past her wrists]], a [[black choker]], [[black shorts|black]] [[ short shorts]] a [[black pantyhose]] and [[white footwear|white]] [[sneakers]].

The latter, meanwhile, replaces the hoodie with a [[long sleeves|long-sleeved]] [[white shirt|white]] [[asymmetrical clothes|asymmetrical]] [[asymmetrical shirt|shirt]] with a [[shoulder cutout]] and the pantyhose with black [[socks]].

Originally, she used her regular hairstyle with this outfit, but she later got the same [[wavy hair|wavy]] [[low twintails]] from her 5th outfit as an option.
